# kitex_gen — generated stubs (do not edit)

Generated by `./idl/generate.sh kms` from `idl/kms/v1/kms.proto`.

After generation:

- `kms/v1/kms.pb.go` — protobuf messages
- `kms/v1/kmsservice/kmsservice.go` — `server.NewServer(impl, opts...)` wrapper
- `kms/v1/kmsservice/client.go` — `client.NewClient(dest, opts...)` wrapper

Server side (cmd/server/main.go):

```go
import kmsservice "reconcile-system/packages/kms-manage/kitex_gen/kms/v1/kmsservice"
srv := kmsservice.NewServer(impl, server.WithServiceAddr(addr), server.WithMiddleware(kitexutil.AuthMW(token)))
```

Caller side (card-center / payment-core / user-merchant-core / payment-admin-web):

```go
import (
    kmsservice "reconcile-system/packages/kms-manage/kitex_gen/kms/v1/kmsservice"
    kmsv1 "reconcile-system/packages/kms-manage/kitex_gen/kms/v1"
)

cli, err := kmsservice.NewClient(
    "kms-manage",
    client.WithResolver(kitexutil.NewEtcdResolver(etcdCli, "")),
    client.WithMiddleware(kitexutil.LogMW(logger)),
)
resp, err := cli.Encrypt(ctx, &kmsv1.EncryptRequest{Plaintext: ..., Context: ...})
```

## 关键差异 vs grpc

- gRPC `grpc.Dial` → Kitex `client.NewClient`
- gRPC `pb.NewXxxClient(conn)` → Kitex `xxxservice.NewClient("dest", opts...)`
- gRPC interceptor → Kitex middleware (kitexutil 已封装 Auth/Log/Metrics/Recover/CB)
- gRPC resolver → Kitex Resolver interface (kitexutil.EtcdResolver)
- 协议: Kitex 默认 TTHeader+Protobuf, **跟 gRPC wire 不兼容**, server+client 必须同切
